data.text:
Idea for getting enough data to solve robotics gpt moment:

Context: there is not enough data for robotics model GPT moment like there is text and video data for those models. Robotics labs are lighting $100s of mm on fire paying people to teleoperate robots in Pittsburgh and the Philippines to collect data.

Idea:
—lots of startups are building teleoperated robots for various industries (eg replace hotel maids w robot controlled by guy in Philippines)
—theoretically this is cheaper than human labor (teleoperator wages + amortized robot capex < in person labor wages)
—widespread adoption = collective dataset potentially big enough for gpt moment training

@SkildAI and @physical_int win because this data allows for GPT moment. Teleop hardware vendors win because they then get this model and already have distribution.

But, we would need a way to get all this data back for robotics model developers.

Thoughts?
